discrepancies.description: Seed inserts into column 'state_name_ta', but schema defines only (state_id, state_code, state_name). Column does not exist in 001_schema.sql.
discrepancies.remediation: Add 'state_name_ta text' to administration.state in schema migration, or omit from insert.

discrepancies.description: Seed inserts 'district_name_ta' and 'headquarters', but schema defines columns as 'name_ta' and lacks 'headquarters'.
discrepancies.remediation: Align column names to 'name_ta' and add 'headquarters text' to schema migration.

discrepancies.description: Seed inserts 'department_name_ta', 'short_name', and 'portal_url', whereas schema defines 'name_ta', 'website_url', and lacks 'short_name'.
discrepancies.remediation: Align columns to schema or add missing columns in schema migration.

discrepancies.description: Seed inserts columns (name, description, official_source_url), but schema expects (scheme_name, short_description/full_description, official_url).
discrepancies.remediation: Update seed statement column mapping to match schema.

discrepancies.description: Seed inserts columns (name, processing_days, official_source_url), but schema expects (service_name, processing_time, official_url).
discrepancies.remediation: Update seed statement column mapping to match schema.

discrepancies.description: Seed inserts UUIDs into category_id (which is serial INT in schema) and omits category_code (which is UNIQUE NOT NULL in schema).
discrepancies.remediation: Use integer category_id or omit to let serial sequence generate, provide category_code, and align column names.

discrepancies.description: PM-Kisan (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) is a 100% centrally-sponsored Central Sector Scheme, but is seeded as scheme_level='state'.
discrepancies.remediation: Update scheme_level='central' and add notes explaining Tamil Nadu state administration via Commissionerate of Agriculture.

discrepancies.description: IGNOAPS is a National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) component co-funded by Central & State governments.
discrepancies.remediation: Add co-funding provenance (Central NSAP + State Social Welfare top-up).

discrepancies.description: Dataset registry contains claims of 1.0/0.95 quality scores with 'loaded' status for GeoJSON boundaries, but no raw GeoJSON files were ever downloaded or stored in data/raw/.
discrepancies.remediation: Set quality scores to actual validated metrics, set processing_status to 'raw' or 'pending' until actual boundary GeoJSON is ingested.

discrepancies.description: SLA rules (24h/12h for high, 72h/48h for medium) are prototype application targets and not statutory citizen charter SLA mandates.
discrepancies.remediation: Document clearly in audit and catalog that these are platform operational defaults, pending integration with CM Helpline 1100 departmental SLAs.
